name: Next.js App Router Patterns
description: Enforces Next.js 14+ App Router patterns including server components, route handlers, and streaming.
content: # Next.js App Router Patterns Rules - Default to Server Components — only add `'use client'` when you need useState, useEffect, event handlers, or browser APIs - Use the `app/` directory structure — `page.tsx`, `layout.tsx`, `loading.tsx`, `error.tsx`, `not-found.tsx` per route segment - Use `generateMetadata()` or `metadata` export for SEO — never use `` from `next/head` in App Router - Fetch data directly in Server Components with `async/await` — no `getServerSideProps` or `getStaticProps` - Use Route Handlers (`route.ts`) for API endpoints — export `GET`, `POST`, `PUT`, `DELETE` functions - Use Server Actions for mutations — define with `'use server'` directive, call from client forms or `useTransition` - Use `` with `loading.tsx` for streaming — show instant loading states while data fetches - Use `revalidatePath()` or `revalidateTag()` for on-demand revalidation instead of full page rebuilds - Use Parallel Routes (`@slot`) and Intercepting Routes (`(.)`) for modals and complex layouts - Never import server-only code in Client Components — use `server-only` package to enforce boundaries - Use `next/image` with proper `width`, `height`, or `fill` — never use raw `` tags - Configure `next.config.js` with `output: 'standalone'` for containerized deployments
